rules.condition: When defining CLK-WR and CLK-RD in the SDC
rules.statement: CLK-WR and CLK-RD must be defined so STA knows their common period and phase, e.g. generated clocks of one master or primary clocks with one common LCM-period waveform.

rules.condition: When the clock ratio makes the interval between a launch edge and a capture edge very small
rules.statement: PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1 must be used, or the clock ratio changed.
Required max transition, max capacitance and max fanout follow the project defaults.
set_clock_groups -asynchronous or set_false_path between CLK-WR and CLK-RD must not be used.

rules.condition: On the crossing paths between CLK-WR and CLK-RD
rules.statement: No false path, multicycle path, maximum delay or clock group may be set on the crossing paths; they are ordinary single-cycle paths between related clocks.
The write and read pointer registers should be placed close to the flag logic of the other domain to shorten the crossing paths.
A set_false_path (EXC-001) from ports i_full_thr and i_empty_thr to the write and read domain flag flops removes them from setup and hold checking.
